parameters.command: =mkdir -p /data/n8n_linkedin/output && cd /data/n8n_linkedin/python && python3 jobs_scraper.py -k "{{ $json.jobTitles }}" -l "{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}" -n {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.maxJobs }} -t {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }} 2>&1

=TITLE="{{ $('Loop Job Titles').item.json.jobTitles }}"
LOC="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}"
TIME="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }}"

case "$TIME" in
  "24h") SECS="86400" ;;
  "48h") SECS="172800" ;;
  "7d"|"week") SECS="604800" ;;
  *) SECS="172800" ;;
esac

FILE_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE_LOC=$(echo "$LOC" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE="/data/n8n_linkedin/python/${FILE_TITLE}__${FILE_LOC}_r${SECS}.json"

if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  cat "$FILE"
else
  echo '[]'
fi

=FILE="{{ $json.file }}"
EXCEL_FILE="{{ $json.excelFile }}"
JOB_LINK="{{ $json.jobLink }}"
PROCESSED_FILE="/data/n8n_linkedin/python/processed_jobs.txt"

if [ "{{ $json.skip }}" = "true" ]; then
  echo 'No results to save'
  exit 0
fi

# Decode the base64 record using heredoc to avoid quote issues
RECORD=$(cat <<'ENDBASE64' | base64 -d
{{ $json.data }}
ENDBASE64
)

# Check if file exists and has content
if [ -f "$FILE" ] && [ -s "$FILE" ]; then
  # File exists - append to array (remove last ] and add comma + record + ])
  TMP=$(mktemp)
  head -c -2 "$FILE" > "$TMP"
  printf ',\n' >> "$TMP"
  printf '%s\n' "$RECORD" >> "$TMP"
  printf ']\n' >> "$TMP"
  mv "$TMP" "$FILE"
else
  # New file - create array with single record
  printf '[\n' > "$FILE"
  printf '%s\n' "$RECORD" >> "$FILE"
  printf ']\n' >> "$FILE"
fi

echo "Saved {{ $json.type }} to $FILE"

# Save to Excel
python3 /data/n8n_linkedin/python/excel_writer.py "$EXCEL_FILE" "{{ $json.excelRow }}"
echo "Saved to Excel: $EXCEL_FILE"

# Track this job link as processed (for deduplication)
if [ -n "$JOB_LINK" ]; then
  echo "$JOB_LINK" >> "$PROCESSED_FILE"
  echo "Tracked job link for deduplication"
fi

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Job Search v4

**Major change:** Process ALL jobs in single Code node
- No more splitInBatches for jobs
- Sequential Ollama calls inside for loop
- More reliable data flow

**Config:** `/data/n8n_linkedin/config.json`
**Output:** `/data/n8n_linkedin/output/`
